JOROBETO 64-A Poblete Street Project 4, Quezon City Dear Mr. Jorobeto: http: //wmv. dilg.gov.ph DILG OPINiON NO. 23 NOV 2017 This has reference to your letter dated 22 September 2017 requesting for the Department's legal opinion on the following issue. The said issue is quoted here in verbatim: "if a Punong Barangay did not get the prior written permission from the DILG Secretary before he engages in a full time occupation during his incumbency as Punong Barangay, what sanction will the DILG mete-out to the erring Punong Barangay". This Department has already issued several Legal Opinions concerning the issue raised herein. In our Legal Opinion NO. 016-14 dated 29 April 2014, this Department already opined that a local elective official, such as a Punong Barangay or member of the Sangguniang Barangay, who practices his/her profession without obtaining prior written permission from the Secretary of the Interior and Local Government (SILG) may be subjected to an administrative case as provided for in Section 60 of the Republic Act (RA) No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991 " (LGC) and Section 19 of RA 6770 as amended, otherwise known as the "Ombudsman Act of 1990". In addition thereto, Section 13 of RA 6770 provides that the Ombdudsman shall act promptly on complaints filed in any form or manner by any person against officers or employees of the Government, or of any subdivision, agency or instrumentality !hereof, including government-owned or controlled corporations. The various cases in the Supreme Court (SC)I and Section I, Rule 139-B, Rules of Court, already provides that a local elective official who is also a member of the Philippine Bar and engages in the unauthorized practice of law may also be subjected to disciplinary proceedings Javellana vs. DILG, G.R. No. 102549, 10 August 1992, 212 SCRA 475. Catu vs. Rellosa. A.C. No. 5738, 19 February 2008, 546 SCRA 209;

by the Supreme Court motu propio, or by the Integrated Bar of the Philippines upon verified complaint. We hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Lega 1/01..e DIR. MARIA LOURDES L.
